newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate unch at 6.37 pct at Italy BOT buyback.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate unch at 6.37 pct at Italy BOT buyback.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 2.5 trillion lire buyback of short term Treasury bills (BOTs) by the Bank of Italy was 6.37 percent, unchanged on the previous buyback, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.46 percent against 6.41 percent at the previous operation for 4.5 trillion lire on May 23.
The Bank said it received 16 bids of which five were met in full and one in part.
